stutterAdvice.title: Stutter from memory pressure
stutterAdvice.text: Most of the lost time was likely garbage collection, and the heap is nearly full. Give Minecraft about 2 GB more RAM.

stutterAdvice.title: Something forces full garbage collections
stutterAdvice.text: Vanilla never calls System.gc() in normal play; a mod (or running out of direct memory) likely does.

stutterAdvice.title: Frames wait for chunk updates
stutterAdvice.text: Set Sodium's Chunk Updates to Deferred (Video Settings > Performance).

stutterAdvice.title: Distant Horizons competes for the CPU
stutterAdvice.text: Lower Distant Horizons' CPU threads (Advanced > Multithreading) while exploring new terrain.

stutterAdvice.title: Loading new chunks
stutterAdvice.text: Most of the lost time was likely spent loading new chunks. A lower render distance, or pre-generating a singleplayer world, may help.
